description: Type-hint based dependency injection for async Python: a dependency is a Client class with connect() / disconnect(); jobs, workers, FastAPI, Litestar, FastStream and taskiq integrations, pytest fixtures.
rules: A dependency is a nuke_di.Client subclass whose __init__ takes its dependencies as type-hinted arguments; the type hint is the only registration.
Do I/O in async connect() and release it in async disconnect(); __init__ only stores its arguments.
Wrap a third-party object (an httpx client, a database pool) in a Client that creates it in connect(); there are no provider or factory functions.
Depend on concrete client classes: there is no bind(Protocol, Impl), no qualifiers and no multibinding; tests swap a client with DI.mock() or DI.override().
A client lives as long as its container: there are no request or message scopes; open per-request state through a method of a client, and do not build new code on NotSingletonClient.
Never retry or wait in connect(): it fails fast and the orchestrator restarts the process.

Use @job or @worker for a process, nuke_di.fastapi.setup(app), nuke_di.litestar.ClientPlugin, nuke_di.faststream.setup(app) or nuke_di.taskiq.setup(broker) for a framework; handlers and tasks take clients by type hint.
Register mock() or override() before anything is resolved; check the wiring with mypy and plugins = ["nuke_di.mypy"].
